sections.heading: Purpose and scope
sections.text: This specification states what your organisation requires of Metrology Maven for its intended use. You own it and the validation decisions based on it. Rows pre-filled from your intended-use selection are proposals: keep, change or delete each one.

fields.label: Regulatory impact of the process (your assessment)
Intended-use statement
fields.value: Results from other measurement systems' reports are transcribed and reported as transcribed; the system does not re-evaluate them.

fields.label: Intended-use statement (GD&T evaluation)
fields.value: Measured points of prismatic features are evaluated against the supported subset of geometric tolerances.

fields.label: Intended-use statement (scan inspection)
fields.value: Point clouds or meshes are aligned to nominal geometry and their deviations are reported.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Give each requirement a priority and the way you will accept it. Blank rows at the end are for requirements of your own.

cells.requirement: Each transcribed result records the source report, its revision and the person who transcribed it.
Each transcribed value, unit and tolerance is shown beside its source value for a second-person check before release.
Transcribed results are reported as transcribed and are never presented as measured or re-evaluated by the system.
The system evaluates only the tolerance types of the published subset and refuses any other with a stated reason.
Every result names the interpretation rules it used and shows whether each rule has been reviewed.
Every deviation result records the alignment it was computed in.
Points removed, filtered or smoothed before comparison are marked as such and counted in the report.
Every change to a result of record is journaled with who, when and why, and no user can remove the entry.
